description: This file defines the MyTimesheetController class in the OrangeHRM Time module, responsible for handling timesheet-related HTTP requests and rendering the associated Vue.js component. It includes logic to ensure a default timesheet exists for the current user and date.

classes.name: MyTimesheetController
classes.description: Controller class that manages the user's timesheet view, ensuring default timesheet creation and rendering the Vue.js component with appropriate properties.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Handles pre-rendering logic, creates default timesheet if not exist, and sets up the Vue component with start date property if provided in request.

methods.name: createDefaultTimesheetIfNotExist
methods.description: Checks if a timesheet exists for the current user and date; creates one if it does not.
